ring: Fenrir — the wolf and the moon
summary: Cut, 7.0 (round 1: 5.5, round 2: 6.5; Caiman 7; ship bar 7.5). Every gate is green in the committed JSON, including the two new ones that caught real defects: internal_voids is 0 and the hollow's floor is 1.16/1.17 mm at theta 70/110. The structural punch items are closed. The sealed void is gone, the fangs now read as round sheathed canines, the hollow opens as a rounded oval, and the census shows 0 creases on the cheeks, brow, muzzle, crown, eyes and ears. The hero is the strongest head in the Bestiarium, and its silhouette is unique. It still does not clear the bar, and this was the last round. Face-on, the head reads as a bulldog or gargoyle mask rather than a wolf: the muzzle is short and blunt (the nose sits about 2 mm under the eyes), the upper flews are still one continuous rolled horseshoe framing the moon (the author concedes this), and the lower jaw floats as a detached scalloped crescent with no visible join to the head. The lower teeth still read as a row of beads from above. The jaw ratio is 1.45 against the 1.3 asked for (conceded). On the shoulders the painted ruff has lost its round-2 terraces but now reads as combed vertical spikes and stacked chevrons. A smooth bare band still separates the head's flank from the ruff, and the cheek fur reads as melted squiggles. The score equals the author's own 7.0 and Phoenix's cut score. With no round left, the verdict is cut; the punch list records why and what a revival would need.
strengths: Unique silhouette: the only Bestiarium ring with a sculpted head, pricked ears and an open maw round its stone (checked against Arachne, Basiliscus, Corvus, Harpyia, Kraken and Manticora).

The hero (hero.png, hero-300.png) reads as a snarling beast biting the moon, with a V brow, recessed eyes, snarl wrinkles and four round canines on the dome. That is the collection's strongest focal moment.
One theme holds face to palm: jaws and moon at the face, ruff down both shoulders, and the Gleipnir cord twisted as a clean rope at the palm (palm.png y 380-560).
Engineering discipline: a new internal-voids gate and a floor-thickness gate, both found by the author, with sections at theta 70/90/110 committed and clean.
The skin is clean: 0 edges of 60 deg or more on the cheeks, brow, muzzle, crown, eyes, ears, ear tips, lower jaw and chin, and the longest seam crease run is 0.67 mm.
The hollow is now a rounded oval with a broken edge (palm.png x 680-910, y 720-1135). The ring weighs 31.55 g, down from 36.96 g in round 1.

checklist.item: One theme face to palm, nothing scattered
checklist.reason: Head, jaws and moonstone at the face, ruff on both shoulders, Gleipnir cord and bindings at the palm. Nothing is off-theme.

checklist.item: Figurative motifs have true outlines, no combing, smearing or stair-steps
checklist.reason: The shoulder ruff renders as combed vertical spikes and stacked chevrons (shoulder.png x 400-850, y 300-560; reverse.png x 450-1250, y 330-560; hero.png x 960-1330, y 300-800). The cheek fur is smeared squiggles that read as melted wax (face.png x 450-700 and 900-1150, y 470-700). The round-2 contour terraces are gone, but combing replaced them.

checklist.item: Faces and eyes read well; a poor face is a defect
checklist.reason: Face-on (face.png, stones.png) the head reads as a bulldog or gargoyle mask. The muzzle is short and blunt, with the nose pad about 2 mm below the eyes (face.png x 740-860, y 380-560). The upper flews are one continuous rolled horseshoe round the moon (face.png x 520-1080, y 560-820). The lower jaw is a detached crescent (face.png x 440-1160, y 1010-1210). The lower teeth read as a bead row (y 1010-1070). The hero angle reads well.

checklist.item: Stones sit in made settings and are visible
checklist.reason: The 10 mm moonstone is fully visible and held by four fangs 0.75-0.81 mm inside its disc, sheathed, plus both jaws. stones.json and report.json agree 1/1, 4.147 ct.

checklist.item: Shoulder ornament not cut off toward the face
checklist.reason: The fillet removes the hard seam (seam crease run 0.67 mm), but a smooth bare band about 1.5-2 mm wide still separates the head's flank from the first ruff row (hero.png x 890-970, y 260-560; shoulder.png x 800-900, y 320-560; bare-vs-finished.png right ring x 1480-1560 in its 2000 px display). The ruff reads as stopping short of the head.

checklist.item: No flat, blocky or mechanical CAD; forms are sculpted
checklist.reason: The hexagonal fang points are gone (sheaths), the hollow is a rounded oval, and the lips have no flat tops. Minor remnants: the upper flews' outer edge holds a near-constant highlight line, and the ears show a bright planar-looking inner facet (face.png x 580-680 and 920-1020, y 265-370). Neither reads as blocky CAD.

checklist.item: Factory stock keeps its hard wall-to-face angles
checklist.reason: The 010 trillion's wall-to-face corners stay crisp (palm.png outline x 420-1180, y 580-1040; side.png).

checklist.item: Silhouette distinct from the other Bestiarium rings
checklist.reason: Only Fenrir carries a head with ears and an open maw round its stone. Kraken's cabochon is held by tentacles and Manticora's by a bezel under a sting.

checklist.item: Reads as its subject at a glance at 300 px, without the caption
checklist.reason: hero-300.png reads as a snarling canine beast biting a pearl. face-300.png reads as an owl-, cat- or bulldog-faced mask above a separate crescent: the ears and V brow say cat or owl as readily as wolf, and the short muzzle says bulldog. It is not unmistakably a wolf from the face, which is the ring's primary view.

checklist.item: Large, medium and small forms; density and legibility at least Caiman's
checklist.reason: Large (head, jaws, moon), medium (ears, fangs, flews, ruff locks) and small (hair lines, teeth, nostrils) forms are all present. The density exceeds Caiman's. Legibility is about equal to Caiman's, and held down by the face issues above.

round2_items.evidence: internal_voids 0, and section-70/90/110 are clean. The author also found and fixed a thin floor.

The widths vary from 0.85 to 2.02 mm, verified in report.json jaws. The flews still read as one continuous rolled horseshoe with a near-constant outer highlight (face.png x 520-1080, y 560-820), as the author concedes.

There are 24 teeth listed at 0.844 mm or more, and the chin reach fell from 9.3 to 8.0 mm. The lower teeth still read as beads from the face (face.png y 1010-1070). The jaw ratio is 1.45 against 1.3, not met (conceded).
The canine sheaths read as round curved fangs with no hex facets (face.png, side.png x 700-880, y 170-270). Reach inside the moon's disc stays at 0.80/0.81/0.75/0.77 mm, verified.
The contour rings are gone. The locks now read as combed vertical spikes and chevron stacks (shoulder.png x 400-850, y 300-560; reverse.png x 450-1250, y 330-560).
They are rounder and twisted, with tip exceptions within 0.81 mm. Face-on the inner face still shows a bright planar-looking facet (face.png x 580-680 and 920-1020, y 265-370).
Seam crease run 0.67 mm, and the throat line is gone in side.png. A smooth bare band remains between the head's flank and the ruff (hero.png x 890-970, y 260-560).
The opening is a rounded oval with no ragged ridges (palm.png x 680-910, y 720-1135), at 31.55 g.
report.json census gives per-zone entries; cheeks, brow, muzzle, crown, eyes, ears, lower jaw and chin are all 0.
The nose is 1.96 mm across, down from 2.6, with nostrils. The muzzle still reads short and blunt face-on (face.png x 740-860, y 380-560), so the head reads bulldog or gargoyle rather than wolf.

punch_list.zone: Fenrir's head (#4), muzzle and nose: face.png x 700-900, y 360-580; stones.png x 620-800, y 330-540
punch_list.change: Lengthen the stop-to-nose muzzle from 5.5 to at least 7.0 mm by moving the stop back 0.8 mm (u 6.3 to 7.1) and the nose 0.7 mm toward the moon. Taper the bridge to at most 40% of the head's width across the cheeks. Give the nasal bridge a visible top plane that runs straight from the stop to the nose leather.
punch_list.acceptance: face.png: the nose-leather-to-eye-centre distance is at least 1.3x the eye-to-ear-base distance. face-300.png, shown uncaptioned, reads as a wolf rather than a cat, owl or bulldog.

punch_list.zone: Head #4, upper flews round the moon: face.png x 520-1080, y 560-820
punch_list.change: Break the continuous horseshoe. Interrupt each flew at the canine sheath with a 0.6 mm deep notch where the fang emerges. Drop the flew's outer edge into the cheek fur over the premolars (edge height 0 over the last 2 mm before the corner). Keep the 0.85-2.02 mm width range.
punch_list.acceptance: face.png: no continuous specular line longer than 3 mm (120 px) along the flew's outer edge, and the flew visibly reads as two separate lips, each lifting over a fang.

punch_list.zone: Head #4, lower jaw and chin: face.png x 440-1160, y 1010-1210; reverse.png x 250-470, y 400-1000
punch_list.change: Tie the lower jaw to the skull. Add a masseter/hinge mass at each corner that descends from the cheek under the 4.22 mm corner gap, so the jaw's back ends tuck under the cheek, keeping at least 1.5 mm of open mouth at the front. Shorten the chin reach from 8.0 to 7.2 mm to meet the 1.3 ratio.
punch_list.acceptance: face.png: a continuous metal silhouette from each cheek down to the lower jaw at x 440-540 and 1060-1160. report.json jaws chin reach at most 7.2 mm, and the lower-jaw-to-muzzle ratio at most 1.3.

punch_list.zone: Layer 'Ruff' (0.6 mm), shoulders theta 20-70 and 110-160; bench layer 'Graver's hair lines': shoulder.png x 400-850, y 300-560; reverse.png x 450-1250, y 330-560
punch_list.change: Stop the combing. Widen the locks to 1.2-1.6 mm at their base, cut their count by about 30%, and let each lock's S-bow sweep 20-30 deg back along the band rather than standing across it. Raise the hair-line pitch to at least 0.2 mm, or keep the lines bench-only and out of the render.
punch_list.acceptance: shoulder.png and reverse.png at 1600 px: no run of more than 4 parallel spikes, and each lock shows one pointed tip and a rounded crest. A 300 px crop of the shoulder reads as flowing fur. DFM stays at 0.

punch_list.zone: Head flank fillet to ruff seam, theta 90 +/- 25-35: hero.png x 890-970, y 260-560; shoulder.png x 800-900, y 320-560
punch_list.change: Paint the Ruff's first row up the fillet to within 0.3 mm of the head's cheek fur, overlapping the sculpted locks by at least 1 mm, so no bare band remains.
punch_list.acceptance: hero.png and shoulder.png: no smooth bare band wider than 0.8 mm (about 32 px) between the head and the ruff. The seam crease run stays at 0.7 mm or less.

punch_list.zone: Head #4, lower incisors and premolars: face.png y 1010-1070; stones.png y 830-900
punch_list.change: Give each lower tooth a chisel or cusp crown visible from above: a 0.2 mm cross ridge on the incisors, a single raised cusp on the premolars, and heights alternating by +/-0.25 mm along the row. Keep 0.8 mm or more to 0.55 mm from each point.
punch_list.acceptance: face.png: no two adjacent lower teeth share an outline, and each shows a pointed or chisel silhouette rather than a round bead. land_widths keeps all 24 teeth at 0.8 mm or more with none unnamed.

punch_list.zone: Head #4, cheek fur: face.png x 450-700 and 900-1150, y 470-700
punch_list.change: Replace the squiggle strokes with 2-3 tiers of pointed locks, 3-4 mm long, sweeping back toward the ears, each with a rounded crest and a single centre groove.
punch_list.acceptance: face.png: every cheek stroke is a lock with a pointed tip, and no worm-like closed squiggles remain. The cheek census stays at 0 edges of 60 deg or more.

punch_list.acceptance: face.png: graded shading across each inner ear and no uniform bright facet. Ear land widths stay at 0.8 mm or more beyond the named tip.
